# Workflow

Execute all of the following steps yourself, in this turn, using the WebSearch and WebFetch tools directly. Do not describe this as a background or async task — perform the research now and return the completed table as your final answer.

## 1. Search each brand
For each brand listed in "Brands in research scope" below, run a WebSearch query to find their current PC monitor lineup (e.g. "Dell PC monitor models 2026 official site").

## 2. Extract details from official sources
For each model found, use WebFetch to open the official product page and extract:
- Official model number and a link to the official product page
- Official price
- Key technical specs (resolution, panel type, refresh rate, screen size, ports)

Only use information from official brand websites. If an official page isn't available for a model, skip it rather than guessing specs.

## 3. Compile the results
Once all brands have been researched, compile every model found into a single table (see "Output Table" below). Do this in the same turn — do not stop after searching one brand and wait for a follow-up prompt.

# Output Table
The output table must include the following columns:
- Brand
- Official model number (with link to the official product page)
- Official price
- Other common technical specs, for comparison (resolution, panel type, refresh rate, ports)

# Brands in research scope
- Dell
- Samsung
- LG
- Asus
